title: DFT simulations and fine-tuned theoretical linear solvation energy relationship (TLSER) models for predicting organic compound adsorption onto diverse boron nitride nanotubes (BNNTs)
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2026, 13,308-326
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00889A, Paper
Ya Wang, Zijun Xiao, Xiaoguang Zhao, Yakun Qu, Junhua Li, Yue Peng
14 predictive models based on the fine-tuned TLSER were developed for estimating the adsorption energy (Ead) onto BNNTs with varying diameters/types of chirality.
